treatment_label: cartel breakup (reverse event; untreated state = collusion)
published_source: Printed Table 2, Panel B, column (11) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01838.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output in authors_code_* to the printed decimals. Earlier: Article tables not available in the project (no data/text file). authors_code_* = output of the authors' Replicate.R line 646 on the shipped final data (README: the package reproduces all tables). Table/column labels follow the section comments in Replicate.R (unverified against the article).
replication_status: exact (fixest with the authors' FE reproduces Replicate.R line 646: -0.317538 vs felm -0.317538, SE 0.114381 vs 0.114381, N 432993; article table unavailable)
notes: Kang (2025), 'Price-Fixing Cartels and Firm Innovation', Management Science 71(11). Package: Replicate.R + final cleaned/merged .rds files (real processed data; raw DOJ/VitalLaw, PatentsView and licensed Compustat not shipped). FE: unit + 4-digit-NAICS (patents) or Compustat industry group (R&D) x year (authors: felm(... | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl)); here xt_vars = naics4 (= cl) so the time FE is year + year x cl; SE clustered by cl. No controls, no weights. Outcomes are IHS-transformed counts/amounts, precomputed as ihs_* (log(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)), as in Replicate.R). REVERSE EVENT (cartel breakup), eligible under ruling 5b(b): estimated in its own regression with the single indicator TreatY x POST (POST = breakup-relative years +1..+4), and every treated pre-breakup row is a collusion year (all treated rows with TimeToY < 0 have year > formation year, verified), so the untreated state is homogeneous (collusion). data_reg_patent_to.rds: 465 treated assignees at breakup-relative years -4..-1 and +1..+4 (breakup year not in the file; TimeToY = year - breakup year, verified), 31 breakup years 1977-2015; controls never-colluding assignees. gvar g_break = breakup year (ID_To). Abstract: 'Once cartels were dissolved, innovation activities reverted to precollusion levels' (qualitative). Unit id uid = assignee_id except for the one assignee in three cartel episodes (226bee8a..., formations 1988/1995/1998 with overlapping windows, the source of all duplicated assignee-years), which is split into three assignee x episode units so that every unit has one adoption date and no duplicated unit-years; this is the only difference from the authors' regression sample and FE.  Pipeline-sample TWFE (raw units) = -0.319846 vs authors -0.317538 (+0.73%).
